tagline: Your bookmarks. Your vault. Your server.
brief: Self-hostable bookmarks manager for homelabbers and privacy-minded power users. Library + encrypted vault. Calm, precise, curated — not another blue SaaS bookmark clone.
criteria: Works at 16px favicon, one colour, distinct from LinkedIn/bookmark-ribbon clichés, uses existing Purple Pain / Ice Cold palette.

concepts.name: Snap Chain
concepts.idea: Two open chain-links mid-interlock — the snap of saving a link.
rationale: Owns 'link' without bookmark ribbon or LinkedIn blue
evenodd weave reads at large; small-size cut for favicons
Purple Pain (#8458B3) matches the live Mantine theme

recommendation: Snap Chain — approved direction. Ship symbol, lockups, and web-icon set into apps/web/public.
next_steps: Use horizontal lockup in AppShell header
Optional trademark search before public launch
